diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch b/debian/patches/lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1125137
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2169164-uninitialized-notify.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+From e5a2a25fafb8ee107c230d8acad694f6b635f8bb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Ben Maurer <bmaurer@meta.com>
+Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 09:35:20 +0000
+Description: Fix NULL dereference in control_write when control_state is not yet initialized
+  A client that has received MSG_IDENTIFY_FLAGS (setting CLIENT_CONTROL)
+  but has not yet received MSG_IDENTIFY_DONE (which calls control_start()
+  to initialize control_state) will have CLIENT_CONTROL set but
+  control_state == NULL.
+  .
+  If a control mode notification fires during this window (e.g. from
+  the command queue processing a queued session-window-changed notify),
+  CONTROL_SHOULD_NOTIFY_CLIENT() returns true based on CLIENT_CONTROL
+  alone, and control_write() dereferences the NULL control_state
+  pointer, crashing the server.
+  .
+  This was observed on a long-running server (27 days uptime) that
+  had become unresponsive. When the server was woken (via strace
+  attach), it processed a burst of deferred events: accepting multiple
+  queued client connections and running the notification command queue.
+  A partially-identified -CC client was visible to the notification
+  iterator, causing a SIGSEGV at si_addr=0x20 (the offset of
+  control_state within struct client).
+  .
+  The crash was confirmed via core dump analysis:
+  - RIP was in control_write() at the TAILQ_EMPTY(&cs->all_blocks)
+    check (control.c:414)
+  - The client pointer (rbp) was valid but c->control_state was 0
+  - The return address pointed to control_notify_session_window_changed
+    with format string "%%session-window-changed $%u @%u"
+  .
+  Add a control_state != NULL check to CONTROL_SHOULD_NOTIFY_CLIENT()
+  to guard against this race.
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/tmux/tmux/commit/e5a2a25fafb8ee107c230d8acad694f6b635f8bb
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/tmux/+bug/2169164
+---
+ control-notify.c | 3 ++-
+ 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+diff --git a/control-notify.c b/control-notify.c
+index ba6a8355cf..0ced0c87f5 100644
+--- a/control-notify.c
++++ b/control-notify.c
+@@ -24,7 +24,8 @@
+ #include "tmux.h"
+ 
+ #define CONTROL_SHOULD_NOTIFY_CLIENT(c) \
+-	((c) != NULL && ((c)->flags & CLIENT_CONTROL))
++	((c) != NULL && ((c)->flags & CLIENT_CONTROL) && \
++	 (c)->control_state != NULL)
+ 
+ void
+ control_notify_pane_mode_changed(int pane)
+
